title: stachys cretica subsp. velata
intro: Stachys cretica subsp. velata, commonly known as Greek betony, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae, native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Stachys cretica subsp. velata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce stress and promote relaxation. Its therapeutic actions include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and insomnia, and acting as a natural antispasmodic to relieve muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
